observations: White retail box for a Poolee brand power bank.
Dark grey or black power bank sitting in a plastic tray next to the box.
Box text reads 'poolee' in a red logo.
Box displays '20000' prominently, likely referring to mAh capacity.
Box text specifies 'USB+Type-C | PD 22.5W | Digital Display'.
The power bank itself has the 'poolee' logo in red on the bottom right.
A glossy section at the top of the power bank indicates a digital display area, currently off.

claims.evidence: Visible on box but capacity cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: Actual battery capacity may be significantly lower than advertised or degraded from use.
risks.proof: Video showing a full charge/discharge cycle with a USB capacity tester.

risks.risk: Charging ports (USB/Type-C) may be loose or non-functional.
risks.proof: Video of the device successfully charging a phone through each port.

risks.risk: The digital display may be faulty or dead.
risks.proof: Photo or video of the display powered on showing a percentage.

proof_requests: Photo of the back or bottom of the power bank showing the printed technical specifications.
Close-up photo of the USB and Type-C ports.
Video of the power bank charging a mobile device with the digital display active.
response.reason: The brand and specifications are clearly identified from the packaging and device markings, allowing for a valuation based on its worst-case functional state.
